Summaries

five sample summaries

[1] She talks about seven beliefs that can silence women. These beliefs teach girls to hide their bodies, be quiet, please other people, hide their sexuality, not trust other women, put duty before desire, and be dependent on men. She says these ideas are taught from childhood and can make women afraid to speak or make their own choices. She also says that these habits are learned, so people can unlearn them. She believes that both women and men need to change society.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
[2] :Deepa Narayan says that in India, girls are made weak through suffering, and this teaches boys that men can hold all the power in the world. When she asked young people what it means to be a good woman or man today, the answers were surprising. Today, many people think the world has changed, but she says nothing has changed on the inside. Can women achieve true equality and freedom when they get an education and earn their own money? She thinks not, because women are tied down by seven beliefs: 1.You do not have a body, Be quiet, Be a people pleaser, You have no sexuality, Do not trust women, Duty over desire, Be totally dependent. Because of this, we need to change. To solve this problem, people need to change themselves, and we must teach what a good woman and man really mean today. Finally, she argues that women do not need to suffer anymore, and instead, men should suffer.                                                                            
[3] Recently, the world has become a better place for women than before. But there are a lot of factors that suppress women even now. The first thing is ,You don’t have a body. Millions of women could not speak to the sexually molested even their mother and this caused the rejection of the body and it became a very shaky foundation. The second thing is to be quiet. Every woman is expected to be quiet and be cheap, and speak softly, it takes away her ability to speak. The third thing is to be a people pleaser. Everyone likes a nice woman who always smiles, whoever says no, who is never angry,even when she is being exploited. The four things are: You have no sexuality. Everyone should know every woman has a right to sexual desire too. Five things are: Don’t trust women.Men make laws to suit themselves. Six things are duty or desire. Women can not have a right to have desire. Be totally dependent. Totally dependent is a good way for women to live a won power.
[4] Deepa Narayan talks about how cultural rules silence women. In many societies, women are taught to be quiet, soft, and polite from a young age. The speaker explains seven strong beliefs that limit women's lives. These beliefs affect their bodies, voices, and desires. Women are often expected to put others first and hide their own feelings.As a result, many women hesitate to express their true opinions or fight for their rights. The speaker emphasizes that this silence is not natural; it is learned through everyday culture and habit.To change this situation, women must unlearn these bad habits and speak up. Also, men must listen and help stop these unfair expectations. Deepa Narayan shows us that breaking the silence is essential for women's freedom and true equality in society.                                                                                                                                                                                  
[5] A social scientist in India said women, be quiet. In india that is called “adjusting” In this video, the speaker tells the audience that women should have seven habits, but at the same time, she said women must change inside not only external. The seven beliefs: First is tabooing the body. 90% of women dislike the body and they reject the body so we should not talk about the body as a topic. Second is quiet silence, speak softly and be chup.Number one point is difficulty speaking up. Silence slices of women. The third is always smiling. Women should never be angry and they always smile. They should have a mindset: your happiness is more important rather than my happiness. Fourth is having no sexuality. Women should not have desire. Fifth is do not trust the women Sixth is duty or desire. Women should choose what we should leave and what we should lose. Seventh is being totally dependent.

Opinions

five sample opinions

[1] Whenever I see frequent news about sexual violence in India, I wonder how fathers feel about their daughters facing such danger. To break this cycle, men need to change how they view and raise their daughters. At the same time, mothers should choose partners who genuinely respect women’s rights. However, as Deepa Narayan pointed out, women raised in oppression may struggle to choose such partners because they were never taught to value themselves. This emotional silencing makes breaking the generational cycle especially difficult.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
[2]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             
[3] I think the stereotype of women, such as the seven habits, still remains in Japan too. The social system has become more and more equal, but the roots, our thinking has not totally changed. I think the meaning of equal does not mean women have become like men, but it means they have the same choice and respect each other. So, I only disagree with her point of “women don’t adjust, men adjust.”                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
[4] I was especially interested in “Be quiet” and “Duty over desire”. I think women are sometimes expected to put their family before their own feelings and desires. For example, after getting married and having children, women may be expected to act mainly as mothers. Japan also had a traditional idea that women should follow their husbands. Even today, phrases like “sasu kyuu (sasuga Kyushu) can remind us of traditional ideas about how men and women should behave. However, I don’t think getting married or becoming a mother is a bad thing. I think the problem is when women are expected to behave in a certain way just because they are women. Women should be able to choose how they want to live. Note 1. You don’t have a body 2. Be quiet 3. Be a people pleaser 4. You have no sexuality 5. Don’t trust women 6. Duty over desire 7. Be totally dependent These delete women, make women disappear But persists
[5] I think the speaker's speech is very interesting and important ,on the other hand, changing long traditions is not so easy in daily life. People have different family backgrounds and social situations, so it is hard for everyone to speak up brave like her. Encouraging women is great, but changing society usually takes a long time. Also, small steps in our daily lives might be more realistic than big sudden changes. I hope everyone can find their own comfortable way to express feelings. So we should think more carefully about this problem.
